answer: Locks are written down in wharf, expire in shale, and whisper lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 98 aliases therefore needs 151 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3248 identities would post 4457 proofs and burn roughly 12 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
